topic: From Circles to Heat: The Magic of Fourier Series

sections.title: The Intuition: Epicycles and Circular Motion
lecture_lines: Complex waveforms emerge from simple rotating circles.
Each circle acts as a basic rotating phasor.
Combining different frequencies creates complex paths.
This is the core of epicycles.
Motion blends into a single smooth curve.
animations: Draw a circle with center #FFFFFF, radius 2.0, displaying a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] at the center.
Place a point P on the circle circumference in #FF00FF.
Animate point P moving counter-clockwise along the circle path, carrying a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/watch.svg] icon.

sections.title: The Bridge: From Circles to Sine/Cosine Waves
lecture_lines: Euler's formula connects circles to complex waves.
Rotation projected creates simple sine waves.
These waves form the basis of signals.
animations: Display a circle on the left with moving point P, representing an [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/antenna.svg].
Show a sine wave tracing on the right in #00FFFF.
Connect P to the wave with a horizontal dashed line ending at a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/radio.svg].

sections.title: The Heat Equation: Solving for Diffusion
lecture_lines: Fourier series model how heat diffuses.
Sharp temperature details decay very quickly.
Gradual heat patterns persist much longer.
animations: Display a 1D rod segment in #FFFF00 using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/rod.svg].
Show initial heat distribution curve as a Gaussian.
Animate the curve flattening out over time.

sections.title: Synthesis: The Circular Connection to Physics
lecture_lines: The heat equation uses these circular basis.
Harmonics describe temperature states over time.
animations: Show circular motion superimposed on a static wave graph with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg].
Highlight the frequency-space mapping using #00FF00 lines.
Overlay the final heat equation solution on the wave, represented by [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/radiator.svg].
